SRC-034:R002.text: CORE-002: rejected ingest leaves no registry or filesystem side effect

SRC-034:R003.text: CORE-003: canonical archive resolution honors ordered alias precedence without a synthetic Archive

SRC-034:R005.text: CORE-005: widget update metadata derives from one authoritative port contract

SRC-034:R006.text: CORE-006: managed-profile liveness is answered from dedicated-profile identity, not aggregate workers

SRC-034:R007.text: W2-001: browser dispatch holds one durable terminal-completion authority with the canonical campaign status

SRC-034:R008.text: W2-002: worker launch intent is durable before any browser spawn and corrupt launch state fails closed

SRC-034:R009.text: W2-003: Win32 recovery transfers canonical single-instance ownership across the stale owner's exit

SRC-034:R010.text: W2-004: Bridge PID publication/deletion is atomic and bound to the exact daemon being stopped

SRC-034:R011.text: W2-005: liveness probes are total over PID values and model each platform's real ownership primitive

SRC-034:R012.text: W2-006: auth regression results do not depend on test collection order

SRC-034:R014.text: PERF-002: steady-state INAUDIT requests do not reconstruct or re-hash the capture corpus

SRC-034:R015.text: PERF-003: permanent Bridge-job storage is bounded and compacted with byte-identical invalid-auth recovery and membership-only index writes

SRC-034:R016.text: PERF-004: first-pack freshness performs no recursive preflight and stale scans short-circuit

SRC-034:R017.text: PERF-005: agent-inbox enrichment runs at most one filesystem fingerprint per represented project per refresh
